title: C02 local profile
description: One local profile on this installation, written by the runtime the first time the installation is used: no account, Team, sign-up or network is needed and no request creates it; `access.profile.read` returns it with the profile's current access state, whatever that state is. Its id and its principal are opaque and stable. `display_name` is an editable label and nothing else, so renaming the profile or rotating its device key changes no record that names the profile or the principal.
